'''Abdolhamid Minouchehr''' ({{langx|fa|عبدالحمید مینوچهر}}; 6 June 1962 – 13 June 2025) was an Iranian [[nuclear physicist]] and [[nuclear engineer]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-06-13 |title=Who were the Iranian commanders killed in Israel's attack? |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c2lk5j18k4vo |access-date=2025-06-16 |website=www.bbc.com |language=en-GB}}</ref> He served as the head of the Faculty of Nuclear Engineering at [[Shahid Beheshti University]]. Minouchehr was killed during the [[List of attacks during the Twelve-Day War#Operation Rising Lion|June 2025 Israeli strikes on Iran]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://ecoiran.com/بخش-اخبار-سیاسی-107/94013-دانشمند-هسته-ای-که-در-حمله-اسرائیل-شهید-شدند |script-title=fa:دانشمندان هسته‌ای شهید شدند در حملات اسرائیل چه کسانی بودند+ بیوگرافی و عکس |website=ecoiran.com }}</ref><ref name=":0">{{cite web |language=fa |script-title=fa: در گفت و گو با دکتر عبدالحمید مینوچهر ; دانش هسته ای و فردایی شدن ایران
|trans-title=Interview with Dr. Abdolhamid Minouchehr: Nuclear Knowledge and the Future of Iran |url=https://hawzah.net/fa/Magazine/View/4892/4931/42129/در-گفت-و-گو-با-دکتر-عبدالحمید-مینوچهر--دانش-هسته-ای-و-فردایی-شدن-ایران |website=Hawzah.net |access-date=13 June 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |script-title=fa: منزل شهید دکتر عبدالحمید مینوچهر که بامداد امروز مورد حمله تروریستی اسرائیل قرار گرفت/عکس |trans-title=Home of martyr Dr. Abdolhamid Minouchehr attacked by Israeli terrorists |url=https://www.ilna.ir/بخش-سایر-رسانه-ها-10/1650353-منزل-شهید-دکتر-عبدالحمید-مینوچهر-که-بامداد-امروز-مورد-حمله-تروریستی-اسرائیل-قرار-گرفت-عکس |website=ILNA |date=13 June 2025 |access-date=13 June 2025 |language=fa}}</ref><ref name=ham>{{cite web |script-title=fa:عبدالحمید مینوچهر که در حملات تروریستی اسرائیل به شهادت رسید کیست؟ |trans-title=Who was Abdolhamid Minouchehr, killed in Israeli terrorist attacks? |url=https://www.hamshahrionline.ir/news/954630/عبدالحمید-مینوچهر-که-در-حملات-تروریستی-اسرائیل-به-شهادت-رسید |website=Hamshahri Online |date=13 June 2025 |access-date=13 June 2025 |language=fa}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-06-15 |title=Who are the nuclear academics Israel killed in Iran strikes? |url=https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-857756 |access-date=2025-06-16 |website=The Jerusalem Post |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-06-13 |title=Six Iranian nuclear scientists killed in Israeli strikes |url=https://tribune.com.pk/story/2550656/six-iranian-nuclear-scientists-killed-in-israeli-strikes |access-date=2025-06-16 |website=The Express Tribune |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |first1=William |last1=Morgan |first2=James |last2=Knuckey |first3=Richard |last3=Ashmore |first4=Lotti |last4=OBrien |first5=Alice |last5=Scarsi |date=2025-06-14 |title=Horror as civilians trapped in tower as Tehran launches 'less than 100 missiles' |url=https://www.express.co.uk/news/world/2068067/israel-strikes-iran-live-nationwide |access-date=2025-06-16 |website=Express.co.uk |language=en}}</ref>

==Life and career==
Abdolhamid Minouchehr was born on 6 June 1962 in the city of [[Tehran]].

After completing his education in [[nuclear engineering]] and earning a PhD from [[Moscow State University]],<ref name=":0" /> Minouchehr joined the faculty of [[Shahid Beheshti University]].<ref>{{Cite news |author=<!--staff byline; no author given--> |date=2025-06-13 |title=Who Are The Iranian Scientists Who Have Been Killed? |url=https://kashmirobserver.net/2025/06/13/who-are-the-iranian-scientists-who-have-been-killed/ |access-date=2025-06-25 |website=Kashmir Observer |language=en-US}}</ref> His specialization was in [[nuclear reactors]], and he conducted significant research in nuclear simulation, advanced [[nuclear fuel]] design, and increasing the efficiency and safety of [[nuclear power plants]].

He also served as the editor-in-chief of the electronic journal ''Nuclear Technology and Energy''.<ref>{{cite web |title=Nuclear Technology and Energy Journal |url=https://www.magiran.com/magazine/about/8522 |website=MagIran |language=fa}}</ref>

===Death===
On 13 June 2025, Minouchehr was killed in [[Tehran]] during the [[List of attacks during the Twelve-Day War#Operation Rising Lion|June 2025 Israeli strikes on Iran]] together with other nuclear scientists, at the age of 63.<ref name=ham /><ref>{{Cite web |title=6 Iranian nuclear scientist killed in latest Israeli attack: Report |url=https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/6-iranian-nuclear-scientist-killed-in-latest-israeli-attack-report/3596218 |access-date=2025-06-25 |website=www.aa.com.tr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Abdulhamid Minouchehr Iranian nuclear physicist and nuclear engineer dead at age 63 |url=https://www.dead-people.com/Abdulhamid-Minouchehr |access-date=2025-06-25 |website=www.dead-people.com |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-06-13 |title=Estos son los altos mandos militares cuyo asesinato puso al borde de la guerra a Irán e Israel |url=https://www.france24.com/es/medio-oriente/20250613-estos-son-los-altos-mandos-militares-cuyo-asesinato-puso-al-borde-de-la-guerra-a-ir%C3%A1n-e-israel |access-date=2025-06-25 |website=France 24}}</ref> His funeral held on 28 June was set to take place along with those of all the top commanders killed during the [[Twelve-Day War]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-06-25 |title=Iran to hold funerals for top commanders, scientists killed in Israel strikes: State media |url=https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2025/06/25/iran-to-hold-funerals-for-top-commanders-scientists-killed-in-israel-strikes-state-media |access-date=2025-06-25 |website=Al Arabiya English |language=en}}</ref>
